summary: Tested DentaFlow full-stack app (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). 17/17 backend pytest cases passed covering auth (doctor/staff/wrong creds/me), dashboard, patients CRUD with role-based delete (staff 403, doctor 200), treatments listing+RBAC, finances summary (doctor only), follow-ups, and active sessions (doctor only). Frontend smoke test passed: doctor login from prefilled form redirects to dashboard, all 6 sidebar nav links present (dashboard/patients/finances/price-catalog/follow-ups/settings), Patients page lists all 5 seeded patients (Ananya, Rohan, Priya, Arjun, Meera), Finances page renders 23 SVG chart elements with revenue/expense breakdown/trend, Price Catalog displays treatments (Implant present), Follow-ups page shows Today/Upcoming sections. No JS/console errors detected.

issues: 'This Month' card shows ₹0 because seed visit dates are in 2025/early-2026 and the system clock is May 2026 — cosmetic; consider seeding a current-month visit so the demo shows a non-zero figure.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~530 lines and mixes auth, models, all routers, and seeding — splitting into modules (auth.py, patients.py, finances.py, seed.py) would improve maintainability before further growth.

Finances 'monthly' computation uses today.replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=30*i) which can drift for long ranges (e.g., months with 28/31 days) — fine for 12-month window but switch to dateutil.relativedelta for accuracy.
VisitForm only mutates patient state in PatientFormPage and is persisted only on Save Patient — UX: surface this clearly so users don't navigate away thinking the visit was saved.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=False — acceptable for token-bearer auth, but document this since playbook hints at httpOnly cookies (which would need explicit origins).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed (5 patients, 10 treatments, 2 users). Test patient/treatment created and cleaned up within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runnable via: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Auth uses Bearer JWT (localStorage 'df_token'). Frontend nav uses data-testid='nav-{dashboard|patients|finances|price-catalog|follow-ups|settings}'. PatientFormPage uses data-testid='tab-0'..'tab-6'. Visits/odontogram changes are local until 'Save Patient' clicked. Note: app uses Bearer-token auth (not httpOnly cookies) and bcrypt $2b$ hashes — playbook items about cookies and brute-force lockout are NOT implemented; flagging if those are required by playbook.
